			"articleBody": "VIJAYAWADA The Andhra Pradesh Lorry Owners\u2019 Association (APLOA) has urged the Union Finance Ministry and the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) to intervene in the reported detention of more than 300 trucks at the Assam-West Bengal border, alleging that consignments carrying raw petroleum coke were being prevented from proceeding despite GST compliance and payment of Integrated GST (IGST). \u201cThese trucks have remained stranded for several days now, disrupting goods movement to Andhra Pradesh and other States,\u201d Y.V. Eswara Rao, general secretary of the association, told The Hindu. He said nearly 50% of the trucks were carrying consignments meant for Visakhapatnam, and others were bound for Haldia and Durgapur in West Bengal, Barauni in Bihar and Paradip in Odisha. Mr. Eswara Rao said the detention had caused financial losses to transport operators and industrial establishments, besides hardship to drivers.",

	var $header = $(".header");
	var $body = $("body");
	var $userEmailDisplay = $("#userEmailDisplay");
	
	// Track if user state has been initialized (lazy init on first account click)
	var userStateInitialized = false;

  // LOADER FUNCTIONS
	function showLoader() {
		$("#pageLoader").fadeIn(200);
	}

	function hideLoader() {
		$("#pageLoader").fadeOut(200);
	}

	// LOGIN (no subscription yet)
	$(".btn-signup").on("click", function (e) {
		e.preventDefault();
		$(".header")
		.removeClass("logged-out subscribed")
		.addClass("logged-in");
		$(".subscription-card")
		.removeClass("active-subscription")
		.addClass("no-subscription");
	});


  // Function to update subscription state based on actual user status
  function updateSubscriptionState() {
    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId && tp.user && tp.user.isUserValid()) {
      try {
        if (typeof userIdentify !== 'undefined') {
          userIdentify.then(function () {
            if (typeof isNonSubcribedUser === 'function' && !isNonSubcribedUser()) {
              $subscriptionCard
                .removeClass("no-subscription")
                .addClass("active-subscription");
            } else {
              $subscriptionCard
                .removeClass("active-subscription")
                .addClass("no-subscription");
            }
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error checking subscription status:', error);
      }
    }
  }

  function updateUserEmail() {
    // Update user email if tp is available and user is logged in
    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId && tp.user && tp.user.isUserValid()) {
      try {
        var userDetails = tp.pianoId.getUser();
        if (userDetails && userDetails.email) {
          $userEmailDisplay.text(userDetails.email);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error getting user email:', error);
        $userEmailDisplay.text('User logged in');
      }
    }
  }

  // ACCOUNT CLICK (logged out view + open comments)
  $(".btn-account").on("click", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    showLoader();
    setTimeout(() => {  // Simulate loading time for better UX
    $header
      .removeClass("logged-in subscribed")
      .addClass("logged-out");

    if (!$sideMenu.hasClass("show-comments")) {
      $sideMenu.addClass("show-comments");
      // addClass is idempotent — safe even if hamburger already added stop-scroll
      $body.addClass("stop-scroll");
    }
    
    // Initialize user state only on first account click (lazy initialization)
    if (!userStateInitialized) {
      userStateInitialized = true;
      updateUserEmail();
      updateSubscriptionState();
    } else {
      // On subsequent clicks, just update email in case it changed
      updateUserEmail();
    }
    hideLoader(); }, 500);
  });


  // Close popup handlers - use event delegation for better performance
  $sideMenu.on("click touchstart", ".comments-close, .comments-overlay", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if ($sideMenu.hasClass("show-comments")) {
      $sideMenu.removeClass("show-comments");
      // Only remove scroll lock if hamburger menu is also closed
      if (!$(".menu-btn").hasClass("opened")) {
        $body.removeClass("stop-scroll");
      }
    }
  });

  $sideMenu.on("click touchstart", function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
  });

  // Logout button handler
  $("#logoutBtn").on("click", function (e) {
    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId) {
      console.log('Logging out user via pianoId');
      tp.pianoId.logout();
    }
  });

 });

	<div class="entry-content">
		
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Andhra Pradesh Lorry Owners’ Association (APLOA) has asked the Union Finance Ministry and the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) to step in over the reported detention of more than 300 trucks at the Assam–West Bengal border. The association says the consignments carry valid GST documents and that Integrated GST (IGST) has been paid on them.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The trucks are carrying raw petroleum coke (RPC), a refinery by-product, from Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) refineries at Bongaigaon, Guwahati and Digboi in Assam. The vehicles have reportedly been held around Srirampur and Bakshirhat since September 17.</p><div class="code-block code-block-1" style="margin: 8px auto; text-align: center; display: block; clear: both;">
<div id="p-tag3" class=""> 
<!--?xml encoding="utf-8" ?--><!-- Ad space powered by WP AdCenter v2.5.7 - https://wpadcenter.com/ --><div class="wpadcenter-ad-container"><div id="wpadcenter-ad-38964" class="ad-350x300 wpadcenter-350x300 ad-placement  wpadcenter-alignnone alignnone"><div class="wpadcenter-ad-inner wpadcenter-gapi" data="posts after 2 paragraph:38964"><a id="wpadcenter_ad" data-value="38964" data-placement="" href="https://www.vantagesummit.in/participate/" target="_blank" class="wpadcenter-ad-inner__item"><img width="973" height="834" src="https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Vantage-Web-Banner-800-X-800-copy-1.webp" class="attachment-post-thumbnail size-post-thumbnail wp-post-image" alt="" srcset="https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Vantage-Web-Banner-800-X-800-copy-1.webp 973w, https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Vantage-Web-Banner-800-X-800-copy-1-300x257.webp 300w, https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Vantage-Web-Banner-800-X-800-copy-1-768x658.webp 768w, https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Vantage-Web-Banner-800-X-800-copy-1-600x514.webp 600w" sizes="(max-width: 973px) 100vw, 973px"></a></div></div></div>
</div>
</div>




<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Where the cargo is headed</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">APLOA general secretary Y.V. Eswara Rao said nearly half the trucks were carrying consignments for Visakhapatnam. The rest were bound for Haldia and Durgapur in West Bengal, Barauni in Bihar and Paradip in Odisha.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">APLOA wants authorities to verify 16 trucks carrying RPC for Rain CII Carbon (Vizag) Ltd, based on a vehicle list from IOC’s Marketing division, Eastern Region, and to release them if they are being held without lawful grounds. As an example, it cited an e-way bill for truck AP39VW-1447, which records a taxable value of ₹17.28 lakh and IGST of ₹3.11 lakh at 18%. The consignment was invoiced by IOC, Assam, to Rain CII Carbon (Vizag), with Shiva Transport Agency as the transporter.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">The cost of standing still</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">APLOA estimates demurrage and related losses for transporters and other stakeholders at about ₹1 crore. It warns that further delays could disrupt production and raise logistics costs for consignors and consignees.</p><div class="code-block code-block-2" style="margin: 8px auto; text-align: center; display: block; clear: both;">
<div id="p-tag5" class="">
<!--?xml encoding="utf-8" ?--><!-- Ad space powered by WP AdCenter v2.5.7 - https://wpadcenter.com/ --><div class="wpadcenter-ad-container"><div id="wpadcenter-ad-38968" class="ad-350x300 wpadcenter-350x300 ad-placement  wpadcenter-alignnone alignnone"><div class="wpadcenter-ad-inner wpadcenter-gapi" data="Posts After 5 Paragraph:38968"><a id="wpadcenter_ad" data-value="38968" data-placement="" href="https://www.bobbagroup.com" target="_blank" class="wpadcenter-ad-inner__item"><img width="350" height="300" src="https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BE-banner-350x300-1.webp" class="attachment-post-thumbnail size-post-thumbnail wp-post-image" alt="" srcset="https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BE-banner-350x300-1.webp 350w, https://www.logisticsinsider.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BE-banner-350x300-1-300x257.webp 300w" sizes="(max-width: 350px) 100vw, 350px"></a></div></div></div>
</div>

</div>




<p class="wp-block-paragraph">P. Venkata Siva Nagaraju, a truck owner from Vijayawada, said three of his newly acquired trucks had been held at an outpost on the West Bengal border for more than a month.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The association accepts that valid papers do not exempt cargo from lawful inspection, but says prolonged detention must rest on stated legal grounds. It has sought disclosure of any written orders, better coordination among GST authorities in the states concerned and uniform procedures for vehicles carrying valid documents.</p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">"Orders from above"</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Transporters have alleged that police and GST officials on the ground cited only “orders from above” and served no written order. Some transporters have linked the stoppage to West Bengal’s crackdown on illegal coal transport, arguing RPC is a refinery by-product, not mined coal. The Barauni Calciners Association said earlier this month that West Bengal’s commercial taxes commissioner had assured it the matter was resolved, but the trucks were not allowed through. No official explanation from West Bengal authorities has been reported.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The standoff comes as the GST Council has recommended curbs on transit-state checks. Under the <a href="https://www.logisticsinsider.in/gst-council-eases-transit-checks-senior-officer-approval-now-mandatory-random-highway-inspections-curbed/">proposed changes</a>, goods in transit may be inspected, detained or seized only by officers of the state where the supplier or recipient is located, and not by transit states. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said on October 8 that goods cannot be stopped in between.</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">VISAKHAPATNAM: The <strong>Andhra Pradesh Lorry Owners’ Association (APLOA) </strong>has urged the <strong>Union Finance Ministr</strong>y and the <strong>Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs</strong> (<strong>CBIC</strong>) to intervene in the reported detention of more than 300 trucks at the <strong>Assam–West Bengal border</strong>, raising concerns over disruptions to cargo movement, mounting transportation costs and the impact on industrial supply chains.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">According to the association, the trucks have remained stranded for several days, despite consignments reportedly being accompanied by valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) documentation and payment of applicable Integrated GST (IGST). The association has sought an urgent review of the situation and clarification of the legal grounds for the detention.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Y. V. Eswara Rao, General Secretary of APLOA</strong>, said nearly half of the affected vehicles were carrying consignments destined for Visakhapatnam, while others were bound for Haldia and Durgapur in West Bengal, Barauni in Bihar and Paradip in Odisha. The reported delays have affected transport operators and industrial establishments, while also creating hardship for drivers unable to resume their journeys.</p><div class="td-a-ad id_inline_ad0 id_ad_content-horiz-center"><span class="td-adspot-title"></span><!-- /23371410655/news_incontent_1 -->

<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Transporters Report Mounting Financial Losses</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Highlighting the financial implications, P. Venkata Siva Nagaraju, a truck owner from Vijayawada, said three of his newly acquired vehicles had allegedly remained detained at an outpost on the West Bengal border for more than a month. He estimated his losses at over ₹2 lakh per vehicle.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The trucks were reportedly transporting crude oil from Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) refineries at Bongaigaon, Guwahati and Digboi in Assam. The prolonged stoppage has also left drivers away from their families for extended periods, adding to their personal and emotional difficulties.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">APLOA has estimated the total demurrage and related losses incurred by transporters and other stakeholders at approximately ₹1 crore. It has warned that continued delays could affect the timely supply of industrial raw materials, disrupt production schedules and increase logistics costs for consignors and consignees.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Association Seeks Verification of Consignments to Visakhapatnam</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The association has specifically requested authorities to verify the status of 16 trucks reportedly carrying raw petroleum coke for Rain CII Carbon (Vizag) Ltd. in Visakhapatnam. Referring to a vehicle list provided by IOC’s Marketing division, Eastern Region, APLOA has called for the release of the vehicles if they are being detained without lawful grounds.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">As an example, the association cited an e-way bill for truck number AP39VW-1447. The document reportedly records a taxable consignment value of ₹17.28 lakh and IGST of ₹3.11 lakh at 18%. The consignment was invoiced by IOC, Assam, to Rain CII Carbon (Vizag) Ltd., with Shiva Transport Agency identified as the transporter.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">APLOA has asked the authorities to examine the relevant tax and transport documents and establish the precise reasons for any continued detention.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Call for Clear Legal Procedures and Inter-State Coordination</strong></p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">While acknowledging that valid tax documentation does not prevent authorities from conducting inspections in accordance with the law, the association has stressed that prolonged detention should be supported by valid legal grounds, with the reasons and applicable statutory provisions formally communicated to the parties concerned.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">In its representations to the Union Finance Ministry and other relevant authorities, APLOA has sought an immediate review of the reported detention of more than 300 trucks, verification of the 16 vehicles carrying consignments for Andhra Pradesh, and disclosure of the written orders and legal provisions relied upon in cases of detention.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The association has also called for better coordination among GST authorities across the States concerned and the introduction of consistent procedures to facilitate the movement of vehicles carrying valid documentation, while preserving the right of authorities to undertake lawful checks.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The matter highlights the importance of predictable enforcement procedures, effective inter-State coordination and uninterrupted freight movement for India’s logistics sector. A timely resolution would help reduce avoidable financial burdens on transport operators, ease the difficulties faced by drivers and support the continuity of industrial supply chains.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The allegations and loss estimates cited in this report are based on statements attributed to the Andhra Pradesh Lorry Owners’ Association and the affected truck owner. The legal grounds for the reported detentions and the response of the concerned authorities have not been independently established in the information provided.</p>

	var userStateInitialized = false;

  // LOADER FUNCTIONS
	function showLoader() {
		$("#pageLoader").fadeIn(200);
	}

	function hideLoader() {
		$("#pageLoader").fadeOut(200);
	}

	$(".btn-signup").on("click", function (e) {
		e.preventDefault();
		$(".header")
		.removeClass("logged-out subscribed")
		.addClass("logged-in");
		$(".subscription-card")
		.removeClass("active-subscription")
		.addClass("no-subscription");
	});


  // Function to update subscription state based on actual user status
  function updateSubscriptionState() {
    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId && tp.user && tp.user.isUserValid()) {
      try {
        if (typeof userIdentify !== 'undefined') {
          userIdentify.then(function () {
            if (typeof isNonSubcribedUser === 'function' && !isNonSubcribedUser()) {
              $subscriptionCard
                .removeClass("no-subscription")
                .addClass("active-subscription");
            } else {
              $subscriptionCard
                .removeClass("active-subscription")
                .addClass("no-subscription");
            }
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error checking subscription status:', error);
      }
    }
  }

  function updateUserEmail() {
    // Update user email if tp is available and user is logged in
    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId && tp.user && tp.user.isUserValid()) {
      try {
        var userDetails = tp.pianoId.getUser();
        if (userDetails && userDetails.email) {
          $userEmailDisplay.text(userDetails.email);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('Error getting user email:', error);
        $userEmailDisplay.text('User logged in');
      }
    }
  }

  // ACCOUNT CLICK (logged out view + open comments)
  $(".btn-account").on("click", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    showLoader();
    setTimeout(() => {  // Simulate loading time for better UX
    $header
      .removeClass("logged-in subscribed")
      .addClass("logged-out");

    if (!$sideMenu.hasClass("show-comments")) {
      $sideMenu.addClass("show-comments");
      // addClass is idempotent — safe even if hamburger already added stop-scroll
      $body.addClass("stop-scroll");
    }
    
    // Initialize user state only on first account click (lazy initialization)
    if (!userStateInitialized) {
      userStateInitialized = true;
      updateUserEmail();
      updateSubscriptionState();
    } else {
      // On subsequent clicks, just update email in case it changed
      updateUserEmail();
    }
    hideLoader(); }, 500);
  });


  // Close popup handlers - use event delegation for better performance
  $sideMenu.on("click touchstart", ".comments-close, .comments-overlay", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if ($sideMenu.hasClass("show-comments")) {
      $sideMenu.removeClass("show-comments");
      // Only remove scroll lock if hamburger menu is also closed
      if (!$(".menu-btn").hasClass("opened")) {
        $body.removeClass("stop-scroll");
      }
    }
  });

  $sideMenu.on("click touchstart", function (e) {
    e.stopPropagation();
  });

  // Logout button handler
  $("#logoutBtn").on("click", function (e) {
    if (typeof tp !== 'undefined' && tp.pianoId) {
      console.log('Logging out user via pianoId');
      tp.pianoId.logout();
    }
  });

 });
